name: Ultra Buffered Oxide Etchant with Surfactant (UBHF)
description: Ultra Buffered Oxide Etchant with Surfactant (UBHF) is an advanced formulation of buffered HF enhanced with surfactant additives for improved wetting and etch uniformity. The surfactant component reduces surface tension, enabling better penetration into high-aspect-ratio features and contact holes in semiconductor device fabrication. This results in more uniform etching with reduced pattern-dependent etch rate variations. UBHF is specifically designed for advanced semiconductor nodes where critical dimension control and etch uniformity across the wafer are essential. The formulation provides consistent performance in both immersion and spray processing configurations for silicon dioxide etching in semiconductor, FPD, PV, and LED applications.
physicalProperties: Appearance: clear liquid; Density: 1.06-1.15 g/cm³; pH: <1; Boiling Point: ~106 °C
